about_the_game:
They Come at Daylight is a narrative heavy anomaly indie horror game set in post-apocalyptic world. The game follows a group of friends, all misfits to their Community in their own ways, going on an adventure to the Zone, a forbidden area around the Community, where They roam free during the day. Fun little journey turns deadly fast when they realize they’re in over their head and there’s no guarantee they will make it back home safe. 

 

The game consists of two different styles of gameplay; days, where the player can move around and explore in a point-and-click style gameplay, and nights, where the game’s focus is heavily on telling a story through a written narrative and frame pictures. These two parts will cycle multiple times throughout the game.

short_description: We were only supposed to go see the Ferris wheel together. One last adventure before all of us grow up to become a productive part of The Community. But we learned the hard way why The Zone is strictly forbidden. I don't know if we can make it back home.
